summary: Created a cryptographically signed shared relay-v2 fixture, TypeScript fixture-contract checks, and tagged Go RED tests for immutable publish, permanent one-time-prekey reservations, atomic 20-way claims, restart persistence, and exact selector-bound replay. Protocol tests/typecheck and the untagged relay v1 suite pass; the race-enabled relayv2 suite fails because PreKeyBundleService does not yet implement the declared v2 API. No implementation or commits.
summary_markdown: `relay-v2.json` is the shared TypeScript/Go source of valid, invalid, collision, expiry, and independent-bundle cases. Run `go test -tags=relayv2 ./internal/storage/repository` during GREEN implementation; use `-race` for the concurrency proof.

acceptance.criterion: Shared fixtures are accepted/rejected consistently by TypeScript and Go validation.
acceptance.evidence: The signed relay-v2.json fixture is imported by Vitest and loaded from the same path by the tagged Go service tests; it includes non-schema capabilities order plus unknown-field, expiry, invalid-root-signature, and changed-signed-field cases. TypeScript tests pass.

acceptance.criterion: Byte-identical bundle publication is idempotent and a changed body under the same bundle_id conflicts.
acceptance.evidence: TestSignalPreKeyBundleV2PublishIsImmutableAndIdempotent republishes the original raw bytes and then submits a separately valid signed variant under the same bundle_id expecting BUNDLE_ID_CONFLICT.

acceptance.criterion: The same OTK cannot be republished under a new bundle/key id, after expiry, claim, or relay restart.
acceptance.evidence: TestSignalPreKeyBundleV2OneTimePreKeyReservationsArePermanent covers public-key hash collision, tuple collision, advanced-time expiry, completed claim, storage close/reopen, and expects ONE_TIME_PREKEY_REUSED.

acceptance.criterion: At least twenty concurrent claim IDs produce exactly one allocation.
acceptance.evidence: TestSignalPreKeyBundleV2ConcurrentClaimsAllocateExactlyOnce synchronizes 20 goroutines, requires one byte-exact success and PREKEY_BUNDLE_UNAVAILABLE for all competitors; race-enabled RED run recorded.

acceptance.criterion: Retrying the same claim_id and selector returns the exact stored bundle; changing selector conflicts.
acceptance.evidence: TestSignalPreKeyBundleV2ClaimReplayIsExactAndSelectorBound compares exact bytes across replay and changes device_id from null to the concrete device expecting CLAIM_ID_CONFLICT.

acceptance.criterion: V1 routes and tests remain unchanged and green outside the deliberate RED v2 tests.
acceptance.evidence: The new Go tests use the relayv2 build tag. Untagged `go test ./...` passes; no v1 source or tests were changed.
